poetryFrame.leftVertical: THOSE SUMMER DANCES AND FIRST FLICKERING GLOWS
poetryFrame.rightVertical: MEMORY IS A RIVER THAT REFUSES TO REVERSE COURSE
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THE HEART HOLDS WHAT THE CLOCK FORGETS
sonnetLines: The years slip by like smoke in the air,
Leaving only echoes of laughter bright.
A fragile film of moments we used to share,
Caught forever in this fading light.
We trace the lines where time began to bend,
Back to the days when nothing felt so far.
When every simple meeting had no end,
Beneath a single, hopeful, guiding star.
The clock keeps turning its steady pace,
But some connections refuse to decay.
They settle deep within this sacred space,
And live beyond the passing day.
We hold the warmth of what used to be true,
A perfect echo, forever fresh and new.

lyrics.text: I think about that summer day when I went on my first date
We danced in an empty parking lot to a song I since forgot
And the first time I held his hand, I thought this boy could be a man
We must've been watching a movie, I think it was Toy Story 3
As long as you remember me and all the ways I used to be
A part of me will always be 18
And time keeps ticking on, it's true
She'll steal away our youth
But that's how I'll remember me and you
That's how I'll remember me and you
I didn't think much of you 'til that autumn afternoon
I never would've guessed it would be you (would be you)
And it was in January when you finally kissed me
In a dorm room on York Street and the rest is history
As long as I remember you and all the things you used to do
A part of you will always be 22
And time keeps ticking on it's true
She'll steal away our youth
But that's how I'll remember me and you when we meet
And that's the thing about time
You cannot press rewind
If remembering's all I can do
That's how I'll hold on to you
As long as you and I remember all the times we shared together
A part of us will never get older
And time keeps ticking on it's true
She'll steal away our youth
But that's how I'll remember me and you when we meet
That's how I'll remember me and you
